# `apps/realmforge/modeler/viewport/ModelerViewport.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/apps/realmforge/modeler/viewport/ModelerViewport.js`

ModelerViewport.js — the Modeler's center-pane 3D viewer, built from OUR systems end-to-end: the panel's shared GPU surface via `syscalls.gpu.acquireSurface` (paint's pattern), the engine's `createMesh` upload + pos3/normal3 interleave (pinball's pattern), the ENGINE `TransformGizmo` (the editor's gizmo, vGPU-rendered, same hitTest), and the engine's `rayAABB` picking math (the editor's pickEntity pattern on our persisted free-camera rig). Nodes carry LOCAL meshes + per-object model matrices, so gizmo drags and motion playback rewrite 64-byte matrices — never vertices. GPU submission is admitted by the OS frame coordinator; CPU animation loops only advance authored state and mark the coordinated surface dirty.

## Functions

### `realmForgeConstructionSurfaceStyle(material)`

Select a deterministic procedural surface treatment only for sourced construction materials that do not already provide a base-colour texture. The style augments appearance; it never changes semantic material authority.

### `realmForgeStableAppearanceVariation(stableId)`

Map one stable semantic identity to a bounded, deterministic presentation offset. The hash is computed once while instance data is prepared, so natural-looking masonry variation does not split GPU batches or add draws.
